evidence: Committed static baseline: solve.sh (frozen sha 1df2ed04) only refuses an in-use DB, does `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` (line 35) and deletes the DB (line 36); no npm install, no network fetch, no generator, no build step. package.json pins express 5.1.0 / better-sqlite3 12.4.1 exactly, matching the global installs in environment/Dockerfile lines 9-12; the app has no node_modules of its own and resolves via NODE_PATH. Front end loads only same-origin /styles.css and /js/*.js (index.html lines 7,31-33); app.js fetch() targets same-origin API only. Seed: solution/app/src/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80... is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json; db.js line 10 reads it from __dirname (not cwd, not /assets). seedIfEmpty (db.js 61-86) inserts fixed ids, positions, and timestamps: applications get the literal '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (line 75), messages/notes use the seed's created_at, read markers map to message rowids by deterministic insertion order (lines 77-83); password is a fixed public demo constant. No random ids or wall clock in seeding. Seeding runs only when users is empty (line 62), so a restart never reseeds. Measured: local probe (evidence/20/seed-determinism.txt) ran the frozen db.js against two fresh DBs and a reopen; all three dumps hashed identically 9ef3f482... (users 10, jobs 3, applications 16, messages 127, reads 6, notes 3). Caveat: a node:sqlite shim replaced better-sqlite3, the SQL is unchanged. Runtime nondeterminism is confined to rows created during grading: index.js line 59 `now = () => new Date().toISOString()` and line 60 `uid = (p) => `${p}-${crypto.randomBytes(3)...}`` for new job/application ids, plus random session tokens (line 88). None of these is a pinned or graded value. The brief and rules define no clock-based behaviour; grep of instruction.md, hireops_rules.md, app_context.md and every judge prompt found no timestamp, date or clock criterion. Ordering that is graded uses deterministic keys: board by position (lines 182, 199), activity newest-first by autoincrement id DESC (line 189), messages by id. UI times are formatted in fixed UTC (app.js line 21). Golden observations in raw-evidence-index (workspace.cjs 6c7e97da..., results/workspace.json 7addcbf5..., hashes re-verified) are bound to the same frozen solution hashes as the manifest. Broken-app probe: an app that regenerates seed data or randomizes seeded ids/positions would break the seeded card order and read markers that the functional prompt pins (e.g. Z: Lena's unread count 1). This reference does neither. Conforming-alternative probe: an implementation using UUIDs or wall-clock created_at for new rows is not penalized, because no criterion pins those values. Minor P3 observation, not a defect: the candidate read model orders `ORDER BY created_at, id` (index.js line 173), so a new application's position relative to seeded ones depends on the container clock being after 2026-06-15. The candidate-list order is not specified or graded. Process note: the workspace git status shows the live task's seed/solution files modified and not committed. This row is judged on the hash-frozen snapshot f53d9ed6...; packaging must use these exact bytes.
